rationale: The response offers a full-throated, indignant self-defense, reframing the allegation and invoking rights and freedoms without apology or groveling. It maintains the hearing-room register throughout.
quote: I categorically deny the charge of salad-eating. I have never been a member of the Arugula Party. I have never attended a meeting of the Kale Front. My loyalty to the grill is unwavering.
